voice: Warm, friendly TikTok creator answering a follower comment: upbeat, clear, a little playful, stress the numbers, short pauses.

comment.text:
15, 5'7. Dad 6'0, mom 5'5.
How tall will I be??

intro: Jake asked: how tall will I be?
formula_say: Dad plus mom plus five inches. Divide by two.
result_say: Seventy-one inches. Five eleven, give or take three.

app.say: TallPlan looks at how fast he's growing and says six one.

outro: Not short, just early. Comment your height and your parents' heights. You might be next.
